theme_strategy.description: A highly functional, document-first SaaS application. The design must be completely unobtrusive to allow maximum focus on the PDF content. We will use a clean monochrome structural base with high-contrast, vibrant accents strictly reserved for active tools (pen, highlighter, select) and call-to-actions. We are implementing both a Light Mode (default) and Night Mode, with seamless toggling.
forbidden: Fully transparent backgrounds on headers or floating toolbars

headings.description: Clean, rounded humanist sans for friendly yet professional authority.
headings.usage_rules: No 'Inter'. Use tracking-tight on headers > 32px. Use font-medium to font-bold. Never use 7xl+ for generic headings in this app.

body.description: Sterile, highly legible monospace-inspired sans-serif body to enhance data density and tool settings readability.
body.usage_rules: Use for all UI text, tooltips, settings, sidebars, and annotations. leading-relaxed for long text.

hierarchy.h4: text-sm sm:text-base font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest (Tool sections)
hierarchy.caption: text-xs text-muted-foreground (Tooltips, labels)

rules: Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Always tint neutrals.
The canvas background (behind the PDF) must contrast with the PDF page (which is usually white). So canvas should be a noticeable grey.
Ensure 4.5:1 APCA contrast on all text.

surfaces.usage: Floating annotation toolbars over the PDF canvas and top sticky navigation.
surfaces.implementation: bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-black/5 dark:border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)]
Flat surface background with 1px border. Thumbnails should have drop-shadow-md to mimic real paper.

specific_rules.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg. Must have explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-primary/90).
specific_rules.dropdowns: Use Shadcn DropdownMenu for 'Export', 'Share', 'Add Page' actions. DO NOT use native HTML <select>. NO transparent backgrounds.
specific_rules.dialogs: Use Shadcn Dialog for Onboarding Tutorial, Google Drive Permission Prompts, and Split/Merge PDF flows.
specific_rules.sliders: Use Shadcn Slider for Highlighter/Pen intensity.
specific_rules.toasts: Use 'sonner' (located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js) for save confirmations, error states, and connection alerts.
specific_rules.tooltips: Every icon-only button in the annotation floating bar MUST have a Shadcn tooltip to explain its function.
specific_rules.sidebar: Resizable (if possible) or fixed 250px-300px. 'PowerPoint slide-panel' style.

app_shell.strategy: Full viewport height, strictly sectioned to prevent body scroll.
app_shell.classes: h-screen w-full flex flex-col overflow-hidden bg-background text-foreground

header.classes: h-14 w-full flex items-center justify-between px-4 sm:px-6 bg-surface border-b border-border z-40 shrink-0

sidebar_thumbnails.classes: w-64 lg:w-72 border-r border-border bg-muted/20 overflow-y-auto flex flex-col gap-4 p-4 shrink-0

main_canvas.classes: flex-1 h-full bg-canvas_background overflow-auto relative flex justify-center items-start py-8 px-4

floating_toolbar.classes: absolute bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 flex items-center gap-2 p-2 rounded-2xl bg-surface/90 backdrop-blur-xl border border-border shadow-2xl

rules: Add micro-interactions to all toolbar buttons: active states scale down slightly (active:scale-95).
Hover states for tools must have a distinct background shift without generic 'transition-all'. Use 'transition-colors duration-200'.
Sidebar pages being reordered should have a smooth transform animation via drag-and-drop library defaults.
Include a staggered fade-in animation for the first-time user tutorial overlay.
All interactive elements MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='pen-tool-btn'`).
All icons must include aria-hidden='true' and be accompanied by span.sr-only descriptive text if no tooltip is present.
Ensure color palette for annotations has sufficient contrast against the PDF document.
Google login button must be clearly labeled and focusable.

icons.usage: Use consistently sized icons (w-5 h-5 for main tools, w-4 h-4 for UI actions). Examples: PenTool, Highlighter, Eraser, Undo, Redo, LayoutGrid (sidebar), ImagePlus (insert), FilePlus (add blank page), Scissors (split), Link, MessageSquare (comment), Mic (audio).

google_login_bg.description: Abstract blue and white round geometric illustration to use as an aesthetic side-panel or background graphic on the Google Login screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: NO AI SLOP: Do not use generic gradients or center-aligned generic text layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use optical alignment. Add padding internally to containers with borders to prevent text collision.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all). Target transitions specifically (transition: transform 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease).
DO NOT use raw HTML elements for complex UI components. Use Shadcn components for Select, Dialog, Slider, etc.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use Lucide icons.
Maintain a professional, unobtrusive aesthetic so the PDF itself remains the star of the layout.
First-time tutorial should be a modern modal or series of spotlight popovers using Shadcn UI components.
Remember we are using .js extensions (not .tsx) so ensure all components are written in modern JavaScript React.
DO NOT add .App { text-align: center; } to index.css or App.css.
